extension.description: Jump between project windows and run their npm dev servers — every open VS Code window in one panel, with a dot where Claude is waiting on you.
container.title: Pitwall
view.name: Pitwall
command.showClaudePending: Show projects where Claude is waiting
config.script: npm script to run. Names starting with `build` are rejected.
config.packageManager: Package manager. auto = detected from the lock file.
config.port: Port the project wants. `0` = automatic: `server.port` from `vite.config`, otherwise 5173. If it is busy, the first free port above it is used.
config.autoStart: What to start when the window opens. Projects already running in another window are skipped.
config.autoStartOpensUrl: Let automatic start open the browser too. Off by default, so servers come up quietly.
config.openUrlOnStart: Open the browser on start. When off, the address opens only from the link button on the row.
config.url: Fixed address to open. Empty means: `APP_URL` from `.env`, then `https://<folder>.test` for Laravel projects, then the address the dev server prints.
config.openUrlTimeoutMs: If the server prints no address, open the known one after this delay (ms).
config.revealTerminal: Bring the project's output channel to the front on start.
config.restartDelayMs: Delay between the stop signal and killing the process (ms).
config.autoStart.lastSession: Bring back what was running when this window closed.
config.autoStart.workspace: Start every root folder of this window.
